purpose: Teach: ピクセル/後味/サビ/霞/無防備/お嬢様/遭う/たった今

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、ピクセル、絶対、なんて言葉、絶対、知らなかったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: You know, when we were young, I never knew words like that — that 'absolute' word. Do you remember?
lines.style: Dry, amused tone. Leaning back into memory with a slight smile in the voice. Unhurried pace, as if savoring the absurdity of time passing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんの、絶対、お料理、絶対、後味、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、褒めてくれたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh, I do. When we were young, you always praised my cooking so warmly. Do you remember that, dear? I really do.
lines.style: Warm, tender lilt. Voice softens on the memory of being appreciated. Gentle, almost teasing affection. As if she's testing whether he remembers the same moment she does.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ラジオの、絶対、お気に入りの曲の、絶対、サビ、絶対、お父さん、絶対、口ずさんでたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, I used to hum the chorus of my favorite radio songs. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Softer, more vulnerable than before. A thread of genuine nostalgia underneath. Slight pause before the question — almost hoping she'll say yes. Slower cadence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、朝の、絶対、霞、絶対、を見るのが、絶対、好きだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Your grandfather loved watching the morning mist when we were young. You do remember that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, almost protective tone. Speaking as though preserving a small, precious fact. Warm and certain, without a trace of doubt. Voice lingers on the image.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさん、絶対、無防備、絶対、な寝顔、絶対、お父さん、絶対、ずっと、絶対、覚えているぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, I've never forgotten your defenseless face when you were sleeping. Do you remember?
lines.style: Voice grows tender and intimate. Whisper-soft delivery. Long pause on the admission — this is the truth underneath all the teasing. Breathless at the edge of vulnerability.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんが、絶対、お嬢様、絶対、扱いされていた時期、絶対、ありましたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: There was a time when I was treated like a lady when we were young. Do you remember that, dear?
lines.style: Wistful, almost wry smile in the voice. A touch of playful self-awareness about youth and its certainties. Slow, reflective pacing. Trailing question seeking recognition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、町で、絶対、よく、絶対、知り合いに、絶対、遭う、絶対、ことが、絶対、あったわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: We used to run into people we knew all the time in town when we were young. Don't you remember, Gran?
lines.style: Thoughtful, unhurried. Soft nostalgia threading through each word. Question at the end is genuine curiosity, not testing — he truly wants to know if she carries the same small memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: たった今、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんが、絶対、私の、絶対、お茶、絶対、淹れてくれたわよね、あなた
lines.en: Just now, your grandfather made me tea. Do you remember that, dear?
lines.style: Sudden shift to present moment — bright, alive, almost surprised by the tenderness of the small gesture. Voice wakes up. Immediate, intimate, as if noticing love in real time.
